environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer. The instance runs multiple containers via docker-compose with shared /tmp volume. The service is accessible via public ALB DNS endpoint. Container runs as root. Other tenant containers share the same /tmp mount namespace. No filesystem isolation between containers.

config.network: Public subnet, ALB with public DNS
config.tmp_mount: shared /tmp across containers via named volume
